# Lesson Plan: Parts of a Plant and Their Jobs

**Subject:** Science
**Class:** Grade 4
**Duration:** 35 minutes
**Learning objective:** Pupils will name the main parts of a flowering plant (roots, stem, leaves, flower) and describe the job of each part.
**Materials:** A real potted plant (pulled gently out of its pot so the roots show), a celery stick left overnight in coloured water, a large plant drawing on the board, matching cards (part / job) for each group, exit slips, science notebooks.

| Time | Phase | What the teacher does | What pupils do |
|------|-------|-----------------------|----------------|
| 0-3 min | Warm-up | Ask pupils what a plant needs to stay alive and where they have seen plants growing. | Share ideas (water, sunlight, soil, air). |
| 3-4 min | Objective | Announce: "Today we will learn the parts of a plant and the job each part does." | Listen and repeat. |
| 4-8 min | Show a real plant | Hold up the potted plant, take it out of the pot and ask pupils to name the parts they can see. | Name parts they know. |
| 8-11 min | Roots | Explain that roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water. | Answer questions. |
| 11-14 min | Stem (demonstration) | Show the celery stick that stood in coloured water; pupils observe the coloured lines and explain that the stem carries water up the plant. | Observe and explain. |
| 14-17 min | Leaves and flower | Explain that leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant, and the flower makes seeds. | Listen, ask questions. |
| 17-19 min | Label the board diagram | Pupils come up and label roots, stem, leaves, flower on the board drawing. | Volunteers label. |
| 19-25 min | Group matching activity | In groups of four, pupils match each part card to its job card. Teacher circulates. | Match cards in groups. |
| 25-28 min | Whole-class check | Teacher points to a part on the diagram; class calls out its job. | Call out jobs. |
| 28-31 min | Exit ticket | Each pupil writes one plant part and its job on a slip; teacher collects slips. | Write and hand in. |
| 31-34 min | Homework | Draw a plant found at or near home and label its four parts. | Note the homework. |
| 34-35 min | Extension (optional, if time permits) | Plant a bean seed in a cup of soil for the class window. | Help plant the seed. |
